title: Book Two · Chapter 33: The Last Question
story:
The last question on Ronan's practice page has no answer yet.

He sits beside Mum on Friday evening. She is folding a finished shirt. He reads the short page once, then looks at the bottom.

A boy takes a small pot to his neighbour. The neighbour puts a plant inside it. The boy brings the pot home again.

“Is that all?” Mum asks.

“Yes.”

She points to the question.

“Read this too.”

Ronan reads it. Why does the boy go back?

“To get the plant.”

Mum looks at the page. “He has the plant already. It is in the pot.”

Ronan reads the last line again. The boy goes back to say thank you. He did not say it at the door.

“Oh.”

Mum waits while he puts his finger under that line.

“I knew most of it,” he says.

“Yes.”

“I only missed the end.”

“That is the part in this question.”

He looks at the blank space. He writes a short answer. The words fit, but he rubs out the last one and writes it more clearly.

Outside, Dad is cleaning his shoes. Ronan goes to sit beside him after Mum returns to her work.

“Are you working tomorrow?”

“In the morning. You and Mum can meet me near the counter after lunch. She needs buttons from the shop nearby.”

“Can we walk home together?”

“Yes, after I finish.”

Ronan looks at the shoes. One has a pale line beside the sole. Dad wipes it again.

“Did you get all your questions right today?” Dad asks.

“I did well.”

He does not tell Dad about the wrong answer on the pot page. Dad does not ask to see the page.

Ronan carries it inside and puts it in his book.

Earlier that afternoon, Leo finished a story before him. Leo closed his book, put it on the shelf, and went outside. Ronan wanted to close his too. He read the last lines quickly.

Now he opens the page again. His new answer is still there. It is better than the first one.

He puts the book down and brings Mum the shirt bag. The customer's name is on a little card near the collar. Mum reads it, then folds the shirt. Ronan holds the bag open for her. She lays the card on top before she closes the bag.

At dinner, Dad asks about the buttons. Mum wants four, all the same size. She puts one old button in her purse for the shop.

Ronan wants to carry the purse tomorrow. Mum says she will carry the money. He can hold the small bag afterwards.

Before bed, he leaves his school pencil beside the date paper. Tuesday is still a few days away.

He looks at the little answer space one last time. The page does not show his first answer now. Only the new words remain.

He closes the book and puts it on the shelf. Then he asks Mum to leave the door open a little.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

pot＝花盆、罐子；neighbour＝邻居；sole＝鞋底；collar＝衣领。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan第一次为什么答错最后一问？
2. 他怎样回答Dad关于学校题目的提问？

## 读句子

Only the new words / remain.＝只有新写的词／留下来。
